news.title: Canaan may sell more bitcoin for stock buybacks as mining-rig revenue falls 96%
news.summary: The Avalon maker has launched a $20 million repurchase program, while most of its bitcoin holdings were pledged or placed in a fixed-term product at September’s end.

news.title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
news.summary: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indices could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

news.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
news.summary: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

news.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
news.summary: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

news.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
news.summary: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

news.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
news.summary: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

news.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
news.summary: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

news.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
news.summary: After initial issuer pushback, the blockchain venue is set to start trading on Nov. 23 and said will list over 70 assets, including Strategy’s common and preferred shares and 59 of Direxion's ETFs.

news.title: Jensen Huang built Nvidia into a behemoth. His scandal puts the entire AI boom in jeopardy.
news.summary: Huang fueled his company and the AI ecosystem with advanced chips and creative financing deals across the supply chain. What happens if he’s gone?

news.title: Nasdaq futures fall as Nvidia sinks 8% after hours on report board may oust Huang
news.summary: Stock futures were sliding Wednesday evening as a selloff in shares of Nvidia after the closing bell weighed on the Nasdaq-100 and dragged down shares of other chip makers.

news.title: ‘The thought of living to 100 terrifies me’: Is Social Security a giant Ponzi scheme?
news.summary: There is already a demographic ‘run’ on Social Security.

news.title: Here’s how Bernie Sanders wants to keep Social Security solvent ‘for generations’
news.summary: The Vermont senator aims to eliminate the taxable maximum, making the wealthy pay more in taxes

news.title: Nvidia’s stock drops as the board reportedly prepares to remove CEO Jensen Huang
news.summary: Nvidia’s board of directors reportedly met late Wednesday to determine the CEO’s fate.

news.title: ‘I’m sick of flying’: I paid for priority boarding, but the overhead bins were full. Was I duped?
news.summary: “Maybe next time I’ll try the other approach: I’ll board whenever I feel like it and drop my suitcase in the first open slot I see.”

news.title: I’m 63 and spending $95,000 on a roof deck for my $500,000 home. Am I being extravagant?
news.summary: “I have a net worth of $2.3 million and my only debt is a 15-year mortgage.”
